chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: Each candidate is already frozen and hash-verified before schedule preflight begins.
chronological_fold_design.denominator_rule: Every registered synthetic race must appear exactly once in the terminal decision ledger after restart recovery.
chronological_fold_design.design: One deterministic synthetic end-to-end suite with twelve pre-registered cases; no fitting, fold selection, model comparison, threshold search, ROI calculation, or real-data access.
chronological_fold_design.odds_clock: The synthetic worker receives a quote function that fails the test if called.
chronological_fold_design.persistence_clock: Crash points are injected after failure-marker creation, after idempotency-marker creation, and after ledger append to prove bounded restart recovery.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: APPROVED_TO_PREPARE permits implementation preparation and synthetic fixtures only.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: Provider and schedule-contract failures are observed before any quote path and become terminal NO_BET decisions.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-02T23:05:28+09:00. Proposal construction uses only the approved EXP013 implementation, review evidence, and deterministic synthetic fixtures. Real schedules, odds, results, payouts, ROI, credentials, and production sources are forbidden.
proposal_scope.hypothesis: The research-only strict T-3 worker can convert every schedule-provider, schedule-contract, and bounded persistence interruption into exactly one immutable terminal shadow decision per registered race, recover safely after restart, rebuild summaries from the ledger, and preserve the full denominator without any odds access.
in_scope: Drive schedule-provider failures through the worker into an immutable terminal NO_BET decision ledger
Make duplicate worker invocation and restart after ledger append idempotent
Map provider unavailable separately from schedule contract failure without losing the registered race
Preserve every registered race in a mixed-failure synthetic card
Rebuild the summary deterministically from the verified decision ledger
Reconcile a persisted capture-failure marker into exactly one terminal decision after restart
Recover an orphan idempotency marker only after proving that no matching decision exists
Run only the twelve pre-registered synthetic cases during preparation
lineage_hash_requirements: A marker may suppress a new append only when a matching verified decision already exists
Every failure marker is immutable, hash-verifiable, and insufficient by itself to prove a terminal decision
Every output retains formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, and candidate_uses_odds false
Every terminal decision references the frozen candidate record hash and deterministic experiment/cohort/race idempotency key
Restart recovery never changes candidate identity, probability, confidence, pair, or action threshold
The summary is rebuilt from the verified append-only decision ledger and cannot be its source of truth
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: Provider failures or interruption boundaries can leave orphan idempotency markers, pending races, duplicate decisions, incorrect reasons, or summaries that disagree with the append-only decision ledger.
out_of_scope: Any claim about actual filesystem latency, process supervision, race-day availability, or operational SLO
Any dashboard, notification, credential, target handoff, purchase adapter, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any model, feature, calibrator, confidence threshold, candidate pair, value threshold, or action-policy change
Any production scheduler, production ledger, or production data-path modification
Any real schedule source, live JRA page, quote request, odds parsing, result join, payout, ROI, or backtest
Any weakening of candidate freeze, schedule chronology, strict T-3, quote freshness, or denominator contracts

primary_metric.baseline: EXP013 passed provider-boundary tests, but its review explicitly left complete provider-to-terminal-ledger coverage and crash-boundary recovery unverified.
primary_metric.evaluation: Fraction of the twelve fixed cases producing the exact expected terminal reason and exactly one verified decision per registered race, with zero missing races, zero duplicates, zero odds calls, deterministic summary rebuild, and all safety assertions passing.
primary_metric.name: pre_registered_terminal_ledger_case_pass_fraction

purge_embargo.candidate_embargo: No candidate may be created, replaced, re-ranked, or removed by recovery logic.
purge_embargo.quote_embargo: No odds or market field is available to the fixtures or recovery path.
purge_embargo.result_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, or ROI information is available to implementation or fixtures.
purge_embargo.schedule_embargo: No schedule version received after its implied cutoff may be applied retrospectively.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: A race whose scheduled post time cannot be established from information available before the quote window must be a deterministic NO_BET. If that race disappears after a process interruption, prospective performance is biased toward operationally easy races, so terminal-ledger completeness is part of the betting-policy contract rather than merely an infrastructure concern.
rejection_gate: Any candidate identity, probability, confidence result, pair, or action threshold changes
Any idempotency marker suppresses a decision that is not present and hash-valid in the ledger
Any odds, popularity, market, result, payout, ROI, credential, notification, or order path is accessed
Any production, dashboard, notification, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
Any provider unavailable case is mislabeled as a schedule contract failure or vice versa
Any race has more than one terminal decision
Any registered race is absent from the terminal decision ledger after bounded restart recovery
Any summary disagrees with the verified decision ledger
stop_conditions: A credential, login challenge, CAPTCHA, access restriction, protected endpoint, or order-capable path is encountered
A model, feature, calibrator, candidate, confidence, value, or BUY policy change would be required
A real schedule, odds, result, payout, or production source would need to be accessed
Any safety flag cannot remain false or stake cannot remain zero
The existing candidate, schedule chronology, strict T-3, quote freshness, or denominator contract would need to be weakened
proposal_scope.target_population: Twelve deterministic synthetic end-to-end cases covering provider unavailability, malformed or late schedule input, corrupt persisted locks, duplicate invocation, three crash/restart boundaries, and mixed-card denominator completeness. No real race, schedule source, quote, result, payout, or ROI is authorized.
proposal_scope.title: Harden schedule failures through the terminal shadow ledger
